newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy pension fund rules said to be nearly ready.
newsitem.headline: Italy pension fund rules said to be nearly ready.

text.p: Rules and regulations for the creation and management of Italian private pension funds are in the final phase of parliamentary approval, Treasury undersecretary Laura Pennacchi said.
She told a business forum that measures could be approved by around Christmas.

Last year's approval of extensive pensions reform removed the remaining obstacles to the launch of private funds but government measures providing a regulatory framework for their management have been proceeding slowly.
Many trade unions have expressed an interest in setting up pension funds and increasing numbers of foreign companies, banks and insurance groups have said they intend to enter the Italian market.
